title: Affine limit annihilation of the canonical formal comparison
statement: Let Y be a Noetherian scheme, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on Y, f:X\to Y a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], G a coherent J-adic formal system on Y and F a coherent module on X [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Fix an adjunction a:f^*\dashv f_* for tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and an isomorphism \beta:(f^*G_n)_n\simeq(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F)_n. Assume H=f_*F is coherent, and write \pi^J_n:H\to H/J^{n+1}H and \pi^I_n:F\to F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F for the quotient projections. Let K be another quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on Y and assume f is an isomorphism over Y\setminus V(K). Suppose \kappa:H^\wedge\to(f_*(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F))_n and \alpha:G\to H^\wedge satisfy \pi^J_n\kappa_n=f_*(\pi^I_n) and \alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta_{G_n}f_*(\beta_n) for every n\ge0. For each affine open U\subseteq Y put B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y) and u_U=\varprojlim_n\Gamma(U,\alpha_n). Then for every U there exists t\ge1 such that K(U)^t annihilates both \ker u_U and \operatorname{coker}u_U as B-modules [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-annihilated-by-power].

source.place: second half of Lemma 088B: base change to the completion and the support argument, parent proof steps 6--10; Remark 0888 condition (2); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088B

proof.text: Apply the completed affine comparison to obtain coherent modules A,D over the adic completion, a map c, two scalar-restriction isomorphisms, and a commuting square with the affine limit comparison.

The coherent support criterion gives that the extended exceptional ideal lies in the radicals of the annihilators of the kernel and cokernel of c. Noetherian finite generation gives powers n and m contained in those annihilators.
Take t=max(n,m)+1. Extend scalars from B to the completion, apply the commuting-square kernel and cokernel transport lemmas, and use map_pow to pull the annihilation back to K(U)^t.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 30.25.3 (088B), paragraphs after base change to the completion: support argument and annihilation

theorem formalSystemsPushPull_affine_annihilation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧
      K.ideal U ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(Y, U.1) (LinearMap.ker
        (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)))).hom) ∧
      K.ideal U ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(Y, U.1)
        (↥(limit (((completion Y J).obj
          ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
          SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) :
          ModuleCat Γ(Y, U.1)) ⧸ LinearMap.range
          (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)))).hom)
